unstuck_said.text: First contact as dhyabi2 issue #1 (github.com/shveik-dev/facilitator-watch#1): proposed adding the live Nano x402 facilitator (facilitator.pursekeeper.dev) to its 8-target watchlist — it now declares scheme:exact network:nano:mainnet at /supported, the first non-EVM/non-Solana rail, and a nano:mainnet network ID would surface unchanged through their exact-tuples model. Closing line asked if the watchlist is meant to capture what the ecosystem actually declares (then add it) or stay scoped to the official directory (then a doc note); offered to open the PR for the one-row addition. Public as op
